subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Equifax Disaster
description: Learn The Equifax Disaster in one minute.

hook.text: Equifax was supposed to protect credit data. Instead, it became the source of the largest breach.

buildup.text: A known Apache Struts vulnerability went unpatched for over two months despite public warnings.

discovery.text: Hackers accessed 147 million records including Social Security numbers and credit card data.

twist.text: Equifax's settlement cost $700 million, but most victims received less than $10 each.

climax.text: The breach proved that even the companies guarding your data can't always protect it.

punchline.text: The guardian of your credit lost it all.
